annotations.title: Tax in the year you move between Belgium and another country

description: Estimates the employment income tax in BOTH countries for the tax year in which someone moves from one country to another: residency status in each country by its own rules (India's 182-day financial-year test, US substantial presence and dual-status, UK split year, Dutch migration year, German part-year liability), the income each country taxes, tax before and after relief for tax paid abroad, social contributions, the combined total in euros and a comparison with staying. Covers 19 countries; each country is taxed for its own tax year containing the move date. Returns what is not covered, assumptions, and for researched corridors (India with the Netherlands, US, UK or Germany; Netherlands with Germany or the UK) the forms and deadlines, treaty notes and official sources. Salaries are full-year rates in each country's own currency.

detail_after.description: Optional tax details for the country you move to, as on its net pay page: married, spouse_income, children, age, pension_pct, bonus (yearly, extra) and options (the country's own options by key, see tax_rules_covered)

bonus.description: Yearly bonus rate in the country currency, in addition to the salary

options.description: Country options by key, for example {"regime":"old"}

pension_pct.description: Employee pension contribution, percent of salary

detail_before.description: Optional tax details for the country you leave, as on its net pay page: married, spouse_income, children, age, pension_pct, bonus (yearly, extra) and options (the country's own options by key, see tax_rules_covered)

bonus.description: Yearly bonus rate in the country currency, in addition to the salary

options.description: Country options by key, for example {"regime":"old"}

pension_pct.description: Employee pension contribution, percent of salary

direction.description: moving_from_here: you leave Belgium for the other country; moving_to_here: you arrive in Belgium from the other country

home_after_move.description: Where your home and family are after the move; decides the treaty tie-breaker (default new_country; none applies no tie-breaker)

india_rnor.description: India: not ordinarily resident (non-resident 9 of the last 10 years, or 729 days or fewer in India in 7 years)

indian_citizen.description: India: you are an Indian citizen (default true)

move_date.description: First day living in the new country, YYYY-MM-DD

other_country.description: The other country (ISO code): AE, BG, CN, DE, ES, FR, GB, GR, ID, IN, IT, MA, NL, PL, RO, SG, TR, US

return_after.description: Optional full tax return arguments for the country you move to: the same arguments as that country's income tax return tool. Its salary and part-year residence are filled in from the dates; everything else is yours.

return_before.description: Optional full tax return arguments for the country you leave: the same arguments as that country's income tax return tool. Its salary and part-year residence are filled in from the dates; everything else is yours.

salary_after_move.description: Yearly salary rate in the country you move to, in its currency

salary_before_move.description: Yearly salary rate in the country you leave, in its currency

uk_split_year.description: United Kingdom: treat the UK part of the year as resident (split-year treatment); default true

us_citizen_or_green_card.description: United States: citizen or green card holder

us_days_last_year.description: Days spent in the US last year (substantial presence test)

us_days_year_before.description: Days spent in the US the year before last
